//@version=6
// Divergence signals are based on confirmed pivots – they appear after the pivot bar and do NOT repaint.
// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// ©darkaries88
indicator("Ultimate Smart Money & Retail Suite [SuperCombined] V9", "USR Suite V9", overlay=false, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=100, max_boxes_count=100)

// ──────────────── INPUTS ────────────────
// Core
int normLen     = input.int(30, "Normalization Lookback", minval=10, maxval=100)
int smoothLen   = input.int(5,  "Smoothing (HMA)", minval=1, maxval=20)
int pivotLen    = input.int(5,  "Divergence Pivot Length", minval=2)
bool useDeltaConfirm = input.bool(true, "Require Volume/VSA Confirmation for Divergences")

// Component lengths
int mfiLen  = input.int(14, "MFI Length", group="Component Lengths")
int cmfLen  = input.int(20, "CMF Length", group="Component Lengths")
int cvdMomLen = input.int(5, "CVD Momentum Length", group="Component Lengths")

// VSA
bool useBodySpread  = input.bool(false, "Use Candle Body for VSA Spread (Crypto safe)", group="VSA")
int volLookback     = input.int(20, "VSA Volume/Spread Period", group="VSA")
float volHighMult   = input.float(1.5, "High Volume Multiplier", step=0.1, group="VSA")
float volUltraMult  = input.float(2.0, "Ultra High Volume Multiplier", step=0.1, group="VSA")
float spreadNarrow  = input.float(0.7, "Narrow Spread Multiplier", step=0.05, group="VSA")
float spreadWide    = input.float(1.5, "Wide Spread Multiplier", step=0.05, group="VSA")
int vsaMinEvents    = input.int(1, "Min VSA Events for Confirmation", minval=1, group="VSA")

// Herd / Chase Fine-Tune
int   herdGreenBars = input.int(4, "Min Green Bars (out of 5)", minval=1, maxval=5, group="Herd/Chase")
float herdVolMult   = input.float(1.5, "Herd Volume Multiplier", step=0.1, group="Herd/Chase")
int   herdRSI       = input.int(70, "Herd RSI Threshold", minval=50, maxval=90, group="Herd/Chase")

// Signal toggles & dynamic cooldowns
bool showFOMO    = input.bool(true, "🔥 FOMO / 🩸 Panic",    group="Emoji Signals")
bool showHerd    = input.bool(true, "🐑 Herd / 🏃 Chase",   group="Emoji Signals")
bool showBored   = input.bool(true, "😴 Bored / 😱 Hopeless", group="Emoji Signals")
bool showSmartSignals = input.bool(true, "🔵 Smart Buy / 🔴 Smart Sell", group="Emoji Signals")
bool showVSAmark = input.bool(true, "⚪ VSA Stop / ⚫ VSA Climax", group="Emoji Signals")
bool showExhaust = input.bool(true, "⚡ Exhaustion Signals", group="Emoji Signals")

int coolFOMO    = input.int(20, "Cooldown: FOMO/Panic", minval=1, group="Dynamic Cooldowns")
int coolHerd    = input.int(30, "Cooldown: Herd/Chase", minval=1, group="Dynamic Cooldowns")
int coolBored   = input.int(50, "Cooldown: Bored/Hopeless", minval=1, group="Dynamic Cooldowns")
int coolSmart   = input.int(30, "Cooldown: Smart Buy/Sell", minval=1, group="Dynamic Cooldowns")
int coolVSA     = input.int(10, "Cooldown: VSA", minval=1, group="Dynamic Cooldowns")
int coolExhaust = input.int(20, "Cooldown: Exhaustion", minval=1, group="Dynamic Cooldowns")

// CVD / Delta Visuals
bool showDeltaHist = input.bool(true, "Show CVD Delta Bars", group="CVD / Delta")
int cvdResetLen = input.int(500, "CVD Reset Length", minval=50, maxval=2000, group="CVD / Delta")

// Visuals
bool colorCandles   = input.bool(true, "Color Candles by Sentiment")
bool showDashboard  = input.bool(true, "Show Dashboard")
bool showSmartRetail = input.bool(true, "Show Smart/Retail Lines")
bool showFGI        = input.bool(true, "Show Fear & Greed Index")

// Trade Manager Overlay
bool showTradeMgr   = input.bool(true, "Show Trade Manager Overlay", group="Trade Manager")
float riskATRmult   = input.float(1.5, "Stop Loss (ATR multiple)", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group="Trade Manager")
float rewardRisk    = input.float(2.0, "Reward/Risk Ratio", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group="Trade Manager")
bool showTradeLevels = input.bool(true, "Plot SL/TP Levels", group="Trade Manager")

// Alerts
bool alertSmartBuy   = input.bool(true, "Alert: Smart Buying", group="Alerts")
bool alertSmartSell  = input.bool(true, "Alert: Smart Selling", group="Alerts")
bool alertRetailExtr = input.bool(true, "Alert: Retail Extremes", group="Alerts")
bool alertDivAny     = input.bool(false, "Alert: Any Divergence", group="Alerts")

// Style colors
color retailCol = input.color(#f23645, "Retail Sentiment", group="Style")
color smartCol  = input.color(#5b9cf6, "Smart Money", group="Style")
color fgiCol    = input.color(#ff9800, "Fear & Greed", group="Style")

// ──────────────── HELPERS ────────────────
norm(series float src, int len) => ta.percentrank(src, len)

f_dynamic_zone(float val, float hi, float lo, int len) =>
    float p90 = ta.percentile_nearest_rank(val, len, 90)
    float p10 = ta.percentile_nearest_rank(val, len, 10)
    [p90, p10]

bool hasVol = ta.cum(volume) > 0
float safeVol = hasVol ? volume : 1.0

// ──────────────── CVD & DELTA ────────────────
float barDelta = close > open ? safeVol : (close < open ? -safeVol : 0)
var float cvd = 0.0
// Reset CVD every cvdResetLen bars to avoid drift
if bar_index % cvdResetLen == 0 and bar_index > 0
    cvd := 0.0
cvd += barDelta
float cvdTrend = ta.change(cvd, cvdMomLen)

float absDeltaAvg = ta.sma(math.abs(barDelta), 50)
float deltaHeight = absDeltaAvg > 0 ? math.min(math.abs(barDelta) / absDeltaAvg, 3.0) * 3.33 : 0
float deltaNormPlot = deltaHeight * math.sign(barDelta)

// ──────────────── VSA ────────────────
float spread = useBodySpread ? math.abs(close - open) : (high - low)
float avgVol = ta.sma(safeVol, volLookback)
float avgSpread = ta.sma(spread, volLookback)

bool ultraHighVol = safeVol > avgVol * volUltraMult
bool highVol      = safeVol > avgVol * volHighMult
bool narrowSpr    = spread < avgSpread * spreadNarrow
bool wideSpr      = spread > avgSpread * spreadWide

bool vsaStopVol   = close < open and highVol and narrowSpr and hasVol
bool vsaBuyClimax = close > open and ultraHighVol and wideSpr and hasVol

// ──────────────── SMART MONEY PROXY ────────────────
float _mfi = ta.mfi(close, mfiLen)
float _rsi_mfi = ta.rsi(close, mfiLen)
float mfi  = hasVol ? _mfi : _rsi_mfi
float ad   = ((close - low) - (high - close)) / math.max(spread, 1e-10) * safeVol
float _sum_ad = math.sum(ad, cmfLen)
float _sum_vol = math.sum(safeVol, cmfLen)
float _rsi_cmf = ta.rsi(close, cmfLen) / 100
float cmf  = hasVol ? _sum_ad / math.max(_sum_vol, 1e-10) : _rsi_cmf
float cvdMomNorm = norm(cvdTrend, normLen)

float smartRaw = (norm(mfi, normLen) + norm(cmf, normLen) + cvdMomNorm) / 3
float smartIdx = ta.hma(smartRaw, smoothLen)

// ──────────────── RETAIL PROXY ────────────────
float rsi   = ta.rsi(close, 14)
float rank  = ta.percentrank(close, 14)
float retailRaw = (norm(rsi, normLen) + norm(rank, normLen)) / 2
float retailIdx = ta.hma(retailRaw, smoothLen)

// ──────────────── MACD & VOLUME FOR DASHBOARD ────────────────
[macdLine, signalLine, histLine] = ta.macd(close, 12, 26, 9)

// ──────────────── FEAR & GREED INDEX (Composite) ────────────────
float fgi_rsi   = ta.rsi(close[1], 21)
float fgi_atr   = ta.atr(21)[1]
float fgi_nATR  = norm(fgi_atr, 42)
float fgi_invATR = 100 - fgi_nATR
float fgi_vol   = safeVol[1] / math.max(ta.sma(safeVol[1], 21), 1.0)
float fgi_volMetric = math.min(fgi_vol, 2.0) / 2.0 * 100
float fgi_volDir   = close[1] > open[1] ? fgi_volMetric : (100 - fgi_volMetric)
float fgi_stoch = ta.stoch(close[1], high[1], low[1], 21)
float fgiRaw    = (fgi_rsi + fgi_invATR + fgi_volDir + fgi_stoch) / 4
float fgi       = ta.hma(fgiRaw, 9)

// ──────────────── ADAPTIVE ZONES (Percentile based) ────────────────
[retOB, retOS] = f_dynamic_zone(retailIdx, 90, 10, normLen)
[smartOB, smartOS] = f_dynamic_zone(smartIdx, 90, 10, normLen)

bool retailFOMO   = retailIdx > retOB
bool retailPanic  = retailIdx < retOS
bool smartDistrib = smartIdx > smartOB
bool smartAccum   = smartIdx < smartOS

// ──────────────── TREND & REGIME FILTERS ────────────────
float ema200 = ta.ema(close, 200)
float emaMTF = ta.ema(close, 800) 
bool trendBull = close > ema200 and close > emaMTF

[adxDP, adxDM, adx] = ta.dmi(14, 14)
float volRatio = safeVol / math.max(ta.sma(safeVol, 20), 1)
string regText =
  adx > 22 and volRatio > 1.1  ? "TREND" :
  volRatio > 1.8 and adx < 22  ? "MANIP" :
  adx < 14 and volRatio < 0.85 ? "CHOP"  :
  "RANGE"

// ──────────────── DIVERGENCES (Pivot & Rolling Conf) ────────────────
float pl = ta.pivotlow(close, pivotLen, pivotLen)
float ph = ta.pivothigh(close, pivotLen, pivotLen)

var float lastPL = na
var float lastSmartAtPL = na
var float lastPH = na
var float lastSmartAtPH = na

if not na(pl)
    lastPL := pl
    lastSmartAtPL := smartIdx[pivotLen]
if not na(ph)
    lastPH := ph
    lastSmartAtPH := smartIdx[pivotLen]

float stopVolSum = math.sum(vsaStopVol ? 1 : 0, 3)[pivotLen]
float climaxSum  = math.sum(vsaBuyClimax ? 1 : 0, 3)[pivotLen]
float pivotCvdTrend = cvdTrend[pivotLen]

bool bullDivPivot = not na(pl) and pl < lastPL[1] and smartIdx[pivotLen] > lastSmartAtPL[1] and retailIdx[pivotLen] < retOS
bool bullConfOK = pivotCvdTrend > 0 or stopVolSum >= vsaMinEvents
bool bullDiv = bullDivPivot and (not useDeltaConfirm or bullConfOK)

bool bearDivPivot = not na(ph) and ph > lastPH[1] and smartIdx[pivotLen] < lastSmartAtPH[1] and retailIdx[pivotLen] > retOB
bool bearConfOK = pivotCvdTrend < 0 or climaxSum >= vsaMinEvents
bool bearDiv = bearDivPivot and (not useDeltaConfirm or bearConfOK)

// ──────────────── DIVERGENCE STRENGTH SCORING ────────────────
f_divStrength(bool isBull) =>
    int score = 1
    if isBull
        if pivotCvdTrend > 0
            score += 1
        score += int(math.min(stopVolSum, 3))
        if retailIdx[pivotLen] < retOS * 0.7  // deeper panic
            score += 1
        if smartIdx[pivotLen] - lastSmartAtPL[1] > 5
            score += 1
    else
        if pivotCvdTrend < 0
            score += 1
        score += int(math.min(climaxSum, 3))
        if retailIdx[pivotLen] > retOB * 1.1  // stronger FOMO
            score += 1
        if lastSmartAtPH[1] - smartIdx[pivotLen] > 5
            score += 1
    math.min(score, 5)

int _bullScore = f_divStrength(true)
int _bearScore = f_divStrength(false)
int bullStrength = bullDiv ? _bullScore : na
int bearStrength = bearDiv ? _bearScore : na

strengthStars(int s) =>
    switch s
        1 => "⭐"
        2 => "⭐⭐"
        3 => "⭐⭐⭐"
        4 => "⭐⭐⭐⭐"
        5 => "⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐"
        => ""

// ──────────────── EXHAUSTION (immediate) ────────────────
float mom5 = ta.change(close, 5)
bool bullExhaust = retailIdx > retOB and smartIdx > smartOB and mom5 < mom5[1] and close < open
bool bearExhaust = retailIdx < retOS and smartIdx < smartOS and mom5 > mom5[1] and close > open

// ──────────────── EMOJI SIGNALS (Upgraded Logic) ────────────────
float atr14 = ta.atr(14)
float ema20 = ta.ema(close, 20)
float highest50 = ta.highest(high, 50)
float lowest50  = ta.lowest(low, 50)
float avgVol30 = ta.sma(safeVol, 30)

bool fomoCond = close > highest50[1] and rsi > 80 and math.abs(close - ema20) > 2 * atr14 and safeVol > avgVol30 * 2
bool panicCond = low < lowest50[1] and close > lowest50[1] and safeVol > avgVol30 * 2 and trendBull

bool herdCond = math.sum(close > close[1] ? 1 : 0, 5) >= herdGreenBars and safeVol > avgVol30 * herdVolMult and rsi > herdRSI
bool chaseCond = smartIdx > smartOB and smartIdx < smartIdx[1] and smartIdx[1] > smartIdx[2] and retailIdx > 60
bool hopelessCond = smartIdx < smartOS and smartIdx > smartIdx[1] and smartIdx[1] < smartIdx[2] and retailIdx < 40 and trendBull
bool boredCond = adx < 14 and volRatio < 0.85

// Cooldown management with per-signal timers
var int lastFOMO = na, var int lastPanic = na, var int lastHerd = na
var int lastChase = na, var int lastHopeless = na, var int lastBored = na
var int lastSmartBull = na, var int lastSmartBear = na
var int lastVSAstop = na, var int lastVSAbuy = na
var int lastBullExh = na, var int lastBearExh = na

cooldown(int prev, int len) => na(prev) or (bar_index - prev) > len

// ──────────────── TRADE MANAGER OVERLAY ────────────────
var float longEntry = na, var float longSL = na, var float longTP = na
var float shortEntry = na, var float shortSL = na, var float shortTP = na

if bullDiv and showTradeMgr
    longEntry := close
    longSL := close - atr14 * riskATRmult
    longTP := close + atr14 * riskATRmult * rewardRisk
if bearDiv and showTradeMgr
    shortEntry := close
    shortSL := close + atr14 * riskATRmult
    shortTP := close - atr14 * riskATRmult * rewardRisk

// Plot trade levels as lines (using line.new so they don't break the oscillator scale)
if showTradeMgr and showTradeLevels and barstate.islast
    if not na(longEntry)
        line.new(bar_index - 50, longEntry, bar_index + 10, longEntry, color=color.new(color.green, 0), width=2, force_overlay=true)
        line.new(bar_index - 50, longSL, bar_index + 10, longSL, color=color.new(color.red, 0), style=line.style_dashed, force_overlay=true)
        line.new(bar_index - 50, longTP, bar_index + 10, longTP, color=color.new(color.green, 0), style=line.style_dashed, force_overlay=true)
    if not na(shortEntry)
        line.new(bar_index - 50, shortEntry, bar_index + 10, shortEntry, color=color.new(color.red, 0), width=2, force_overlay=true)
        line.new(bar_index - 50, shortSL, bar_index + 10, shortSL, color=color.new(color.red, 0), style=line.style_dashed, force_overlay=true)
        line.new(bar_index - 50, shortTP, bar_index + 10, shortTP, color=color.new(color.green, 0), style=line.style_dashed, force_overlay=true)

// ──────────────── PLOTS (Oscillator Pane) ────────────────
pRetail = plot(showSmartRetail ? retailIdx : na, "Retail", color=retailCol, linewidth=2)
pSmart  = plot(showSmartRetail ? smartIdx : na, "Smart", color=smartCol, linewidth=2)
hline(50, "Midline", color=color.gray, linestyle=hline.style_dotted)

pHi = plot(100, "Max", color=na)
pLo = plot(0, "Min", color=na)
fill(pHi, pLo, 100, 90, color.new(#089981, 80), color.new(chart.bg_color, 100), "Bull Zone")
fill(pLo, pHi, 10, 0, color.new(chart.bg_color, 100), color.new(#f23645, 80), "Bear Zone")

plot(showDeltaHist ? deltaNormPlot : na, "Delta", style=plot.style_columns, color=deltaNormPlot >= 0 ? color.new(#00ff00, 70) : color.new(#ff0000, 70), histbase=0)

plot(showFGI ? fgi : na, "FGI", color=fgiCol, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line)

plotshape(bullDiv ? 5 : na, "Bull Div", shape.triangleup, location.bottom, color=#089981, size=size.small, offset=-pivotLen)
plotshape(bearDiv ? 95 : na, "Bear Div", shape.triangledown, location.top, color=#f23645, size=size.small, offset=-pivotLen)

plotshape(vsaStopVol ? 95 : na, "Stop Vol", shape.circle, location.absolute, color=color.new(#089981, 50), size=size.tiny, text="Stop\nVol", textcolor=color.green)
plotshape(vsaBuyClimax ? 5 : na, "Buy Climax", shape.circle, location.absolute, color=color.new(#f23645, 50), size=size.tiny, text="Buy\nClx", textcolor=color.red)

// ──────────────── COLORED CANDLES ────────────────
color sentCol = switch
    retailIdx > 80 and smartIdx > 70 => color.new(#ff0000, 50)
    retailIdx < 20 and smartIdx < 30 => color.new(#00ff00, 50)
    retailIdx > 60 => color.new(#ff9800, 50)
    retailIdx < 40 => color.new(#00bcd4, 50)
    => color.gray

plotcandle(colorCandles ? open : na, colorCandles ? high : na, colorCandles ? low : na, colorCandles ? close : na,
  "Sentiment Candles", sentCol, sentCol, force_overlay=true)

// ──────────────── EMOJI LABELS WITH DYNAMIC COOLDOWNS ────────────────
if cooldown(lastFOMO, coolFOMO) and showFOMO and fomoCond
    label.new(bar_index, high, "🔥 FOMO", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.red, 70), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastFOMO := bar_index
if cooldown(lastPanic, coolFOMO) and showFOMO and panicCond
    label.new(bar_index, low, "🩸 Panic", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.green, 70), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastPanic := bar_index
if cooldown(lastHerd, coolHerd) and showHerd and herdCond
    label.new(bar_index, high, "🐑 Herd", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.orange, 70), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastHerd := bar_index
if cooldown(lastChase, coolHerd) and showHerd and chaseCond
    label.new(bar_index, high, "🏃 Chase", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.maroon, 70), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastChase := bar_index
if cooldown(lastHopeless, coolBored) and showBored and hopelessCond
    label.new(bar_index, low, "😱 Hopeless", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.teal, 70), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastHopeless := bar_index
if cooldown(lastBored, coolBored) and showBored and boredCond
    label.new(bar_index, close, "😴 Bored", style=label.style_label_center, color=color.new(color.gray, 70), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastBored := bar_index

// Exhaustion labels
if cooldown(lastBullExh, coolExhaust) and showExhaust and bullExhaust
    label.new(bar_index, high, "⚡ Bull Exh", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(#ff9800, 20), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastBullExh := bar_index
if cooldown(lastBearExh, coolExhaust) and showExhaust and bearExhaust
    label.new(bar_index, low, "⚡ Bear Exh", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(#00bcd4, 20), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastBearExh := bar_index

if cooldown(lastSmartBull, coolSmart) and showSmartSignals and bullDiv
    label.new(bar_index - pivotLen, low[pivotLen], "🔵 Smart Buy", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(#089981, 20), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastSmartBull := bar_index
if cooldown(lastSmartBear, coolSmart) and showSmartSignals and bearDiv
    label.new(bar_index - pivotLen, high[pivotLen], "🔴 Smart Sell", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(#f23645, 20), textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal, force_overlay=true)
    lastSmartBear := bar_index

if cooldown(lastVSAstop, coolVSA) and showVSAmark and vsaStopVol
    label.new(bar_index, high, "⚪ Stop Vol", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(#089981, 80), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, force_overlay=true)
    lastVSAstop := bar_index
if cooldown(lastVSAbuy, coolVSA) and showVSAmark and vsaBuyClimax
    label.new(bar_index, low, "⚫ Buy Climax", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(#f23645, 80), textcolor=color.white, size=size.small, force_overlay=true)
    lastVSAbuy := bar_index

// ──────────────── HIGHER TIMEFRAME SENTIMENT (Daily) ────────────────
float dailyClose = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", close[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
float dailyRetail = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", retailIdx[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
float dailySmart  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", smartIdx[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
string dailyPhase = dailyRetail > 70 ? "FOMO" : dailyRetail < 30 ? "Panic" : "Neutral"

// ──────────────── DASHBOARD ────────────────
if showDashboard and barstate.islast
    var table dash = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 17, border_width=1, border_color=color.new(color.gray, 50), frame_width=1, frame_color=color.new(color.gray, 50), force_overlay=true)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 0, "🚀 USR Suite", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 80), text_halign=text.align_left, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 0, syminfo.ticker, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 80), text_halign=text.align_right, text_size=size.small)
    
    string retailStat = retailFOMO ? "🔥 FOMO" : retailPanic ? "🩸 Panic" : "Neutral"
    string smartStat = smartDistrib ? "🚫 Distr" : smartAccum ? "🟢 Accum" : "Neutral"
    string phase = bullDiv ? "🔵 Buy Area" : bearDiv ? "🔴 Sell Area" : bullExhaust ? "⚡ Bull Exh" : bearExhaust ? "⚡ Bear Exh" : "➡️ Trending"
    string exhStat = bullExhaust ? "⚡ Bull Exhaustion" : bearExhaust ? "⚡ Bear Exhaustion" : "None"
    
    string cvdDir = cvdTrend > 0 ? "▲ Rising" : cvdTrend < 0 ? "▼ Falling" : "─ Flat"
    color cvdDirCol = cvdTrend > 0 ? color.green : cvdTrend < 0 ? color.red : color.gray
    
    string deltaNow = (barDelta > 0 ? "▲ Pos (" : barDelta < 0 ? "▼ Neg (" : "─ Zero (") + str.tostring(barDelta, format.volume) + ")"
    color deltaCol = barDelta > 0 ? color.green : barDelta < 0 ? color.red : color.gray
    
    string vsaLast = vsaStopVol ? "⚪ Stop Vol" : vsaBuyClimax ? "⚫ Buy Climax" : "None"
    string trendDir = trendBull ? "🐂 MTF Bull" : "🐻 MTF Bear"
    string inControl = smartIdx > retailIdx ? "🧠 Smart Money" : "🛒 Retail"
    color controlCol = smartIdx > retailIdx ? color.blue : color.red
    
    table.cell(dash, 0, 1, "Control", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 1, inControl, text_color=controlCol, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    
    table.cell(dash, 0, 2, "Regime", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 2, regText, text_color=color.yellow, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 3, "Trend (MTF)", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 3, trendDir, text_color=trendBull ? color.green : color.red, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 4, "Retail", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 4, retailStat, text_color=retailFOMO ? #f23645 : retailPanic ? #089981 : retailIdx > 50 ? color.new(#f23645, 30) : color.new(#089981, 30), bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 5, "Smart", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 5, smartStat, text_color=smartDistrib ? #f23645 : smartAccum ? #089981 : smartIdx > 50 ? color.new(#089981, 30) : color.new(#f23645, 30), bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 6, "Phase", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 6, phase, text_color=bullDiv ? #089981 : bearDiv ? #f23645 : color.yellow, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 7, "Exhaustion", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 7, exhStat, text_color=bullExhaust ? color.orange : bearExhaust ? color.aqua : color.gray, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 8, "CVD Trend", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 8, cvdDir, text_color=cvdDirCol, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 9, "Delta Now", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 9, deltaNow, text_color=deltaCol, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 10, "Fear/Greed", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 10, str.tostring(fgi, "#"), text_color=fgi > 50 ? color.red : color.green, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    
    table.cell(dash, 0, 11, "RSI (14)", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 11, str.tostring(rsi, "#.##"), text_color=rsi > 50 ? color.green : color.red, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 12, "MACD", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 12, macdLine > signalLine ? "Bullish" : "Bearish", text_color=macdLine > signalLine ? color.green : color.red, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 13, "Volume", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 13, str.tostring(safeVol, format.volume), text_color=close > open ? color.green : color.red, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 14, "VSA Last", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 14, vsaLast, text_color=vsaStopVol ? color.green : vsaBuyClimax ? color.red : color.gray, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 15, "Div Strength", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 15, not na(bullStrength) ? strengthStars(bullStrength) : not na(bearStrength) ? strengthStars(bearStrength) : "—", 
               text_color=color.yellow, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 16, "D1 Sentiment", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 16, dailyPhase + " (" + str.tostring(dailyRetail, "#") + "/" + str.tostring(dailySmart, "#") + ")", 
               text_color=dailyRetail > 50 ? color.red : color.green, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 60), text_size=size.small)

// ──────────────── ALERTS WITH ENRICHED MESSAGES ────────────────
string alertBase = syminfo.tickerid + " " + timeframe.period + " | "
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if alertSmartBuy and bullDiv
        alert(alertBase + "Smart Buying @ " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
    if alertSmartSell and bearDiv
        alert(alertBase + "Smart Selling @ " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
    if alertRetailExtr and (retailFOMO or retailPanic)
        alert(alertBase + "Retail Extreme: " + (retailFOMO ? "FOMO" : "Panic"), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
    if alertDivAny and (bullDiv or bearDiv)
        alert(alertBase + "Divergence: " + (bullDiv ? "Bullish" : "Bearish") + " | Price: " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
